description: Historical supply or borrow APY for a reserve over time, on v3 or v4. Returns a time-series of {date, apyPct}, where apyPct is a percent ('3.32' means 3.32%). Each point is an average over its sampling interval, and the interval widens with the window (hourly for 'day', coarser above that), so a series is not directly comparable to the instantaneous rate from get_reserve_details. Use get_markets first for the reserveId (v4) or market+token (v3). When comparing v3 against v4 for the same asset (a migration decision), read the history on both sides: a spot-rate gap can be one side's momentary spike.

market.description: v3 only: market pool address (from get_markets).

reserveId.description: v4 only: the reserveId from get_markets, copied verbatim.

version.description: Optional: inferred from the reserve selector ('reserveId' is v4, 'market'+'token'+'chainId' is v3). Send it to be explicit, or if you somehow set both.

name: get_apy_history
title: Get APY history
